**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Documents a WebAPI distribution of a resource using property structure aligned with OpenAPI Specification 3.1. Reuses CDIF schema.org-based WebAPI metadata (serviceType, termsOfService, documentation) and adds OpenAPI-aligned Operation, Parameter, RequestBody, and Response structure under an oas namespace. Use as an alternative to schemaorgProperties/webAPI when the metadata record should inline OpenAPI-style operation, parameter, and response detail. :title: "CDIF OpenAPI-aligned WebAPI distribution" :rdfType: ``schema:WebAPI`` :noId:

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
title of the API. Maps OpenAPI info.title.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
description of the API. Maps OpenAPI info.description. May use CommonMark.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
identifier for the kind of service, expected to identify the service type and version. For interoperability, ideally a resolvable identifier; otherwise a string from a vocabulary shared between provider and consumer. Subsumes OpenAPI info.version when the service-type identifier includes versioning.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
SPDX license identifier expression for the API itself, per OpenAPI License Object. Use schema:license at the resource (parent) level for licensing of the data. If only a URL identifier is available rather than an SPDX id, encode as a labeled link (#/$defs/Reference). :alternativeOverrides: {"string": {"default": null}} :jsonName: "spdx:license"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
an OpenAPI-aligned operation. Corresponds to one OpenAPI Operation Object; the path component of OAS Path Item is folded into schema:target/schema:urlTemplate together with the server URL. :rdfType: ``schema:Action | schema:AssessAction | schema:ConsumeAction | schema:ControlAction | schema:CreateAction | schema:DeleteAction | schema:FindAction | schema:InteractAction | schema:MoveAction | schema:PlayAction | schema:SearchAction | schema:TransferAction | schema:UpdateAction`` :typeDefault: ``schema:Action`` :typeOptional:

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
identifier for the operation. Maps OpenAPI operationId.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
description of the operation. Maps OpenAPI Operation.description.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
endpoint URL template, HTTP method, and the OpenAPI-shaped parameters, request body, and responses for the operation. :rdfType: ``schema:EntryPoint`` :typeDefault: ``schema:EntryPoint`` :typeOptional: :noId:

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
full URL template (RFC 6570) for invoking the operation; concatenation of the OpenAPI server URL and the path. Parameters are enclosed in curly braces {..} and MUST be documented in oas:parameters.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
HTTP method for the operation. Default GET. :default: ["GET"]

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
request body for the operation (typically POST/PUT/PATCH). Maps OpenAPI Request Body Object. :jsonName: "oas:requestBody"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
possible responses returned by the operation. Maps OpenAPI Responses Object; each item carries an explicit oas:code rather than using the HTTP code as a map key. :jsonName: "oas:response"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
an OpenAPI Parameter Object; describes a single parameter of an operation. :prefix: ``oas``

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
name of the parameter (case-sensitive). For path parameters, MUST match a {template} expression in schema:urlTemplate.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
description of the parameter, including serialization or semantic notes.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
whether the parameter is mandatory. MUST be true if oas:in is "path". :default: false

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
schema describing the parameter value type, format, and any pattern.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
a minimal OpenAPI Schema Object. The full OAS Schema Object is a superset of JSON Schema 2020-12; this BB requires only a basic type/format/pattern/enum/$ref shape sufficient to describe parameter and response payload types in CDIF metadata. For richer schemas, use oas:$ref to point at an external schema document. :prefix: ``oas``

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
regular expression the value must match (string types).

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
reference to an external JSON Schema or XML Schema document describing a complex payload structure.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
an OpenAPI Request Body Object; describes the body of a write request. :prefix: ``schema``

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
representations the request body may take. Maps OpenAPI Request Body content map; each item carries its own schema:encodingFormat instead of using media type as a map key. :jsonName: "oas:content"

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
an OpenAPI Media Type Object; describes the structure of one media-type representation in a request body or response. :prefix: ``schema``

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
registered MIME type for this representation (e.g. application/json, text/csv). Replaces OpenAPI's media-type map key.

**CDIF**
Definition ==========
schema describing the structure of the payload. May reference an external JSON Schema or XML Schema document via oas:$ref. For tabular outputs, the referenced schema may align with InstanceVariable definitions in cdifInstanceVariable. :jsonName: "oas:schema"
